title: Australia-wide rallies warn freebirths will soar under new rules
byline: Cason Ho; Olivana Lathouris; Nandini Dhir; Jess Scully; Madigan Landry; Joshua McIntosh; Chloe Henville; Stacey Pestrin
paragraphs: Thousands across Australia have protested changes to insurance rules that advocates say will make it more difficult for people to homebirth.
An exemption allowing private midwives to attend homebirths without indemnity insurance will be scrapped in the new year.
Homebirth Australia has organised rallies at 26 locations across the country.
